channel.title: AgentScout
channel.description: Latest AI agent tools and agent news from AgentScout.

item.title: Acronis report puts AI agent attacks on DevSecOps radar
item.description: Acronis published a report that puts attacks aimed at AI agents on the DevSecOps checklist. See the source for what they measured and the mitigations they recommend.

item.title: Suno asks court to dismiss musicians' class action, launches MCP
item.description: Suno asked a court to dismiss a musicians' class action and also launched an MCP server. See the source for the legal filing and what the MCP endpoint exposes.

item.title: Diagrid’s Dapr 1.19 lightens AI agent workflows and drops a control-plane service
item.description: Diagrid released Dapr 1.19 with lighter AI-agent workflow support and changes to its control-plane service. See the source for the release notes.

item.title: Filesystem MCP Server
item.description: The official Filesystem MCP Server from the Model Context Protocol project gives Claude, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP clients sandboxed read, write, edit, search and move access to only the folders you allow, installed with npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem or the mcp/filesystem Docker image.

item.title: Novera
item.description: Novera is an independent AI assistant from TRON-ABS for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android that runs local text models with a 32k context, plus key-free web search and local FLUX.2 Klein image and ACE-Step music trials, with an experimental WebGPU browser version.

item.title: Html2MP4
item.description: Html2MP4 converts HTML, CSS and GSAP animations or a text prompt into downloadable MP4 videos for launches, product showcases and social stories, with editable templates, brand kits, a website-to-video mode and an MCP server for agents; new accounts start with 3 free credits.

item.title: Seedance 2.5
item.description: Seedance 2.5 is a web studio for generating cinematic videos from text, images or multiple references with the Seedance 2.5 model and others, then continuing in built-in image, audio, editing and asset tools; monthly credit plans start at $29.90.

item.title: Lanesra AI
item.description: Lanesra AI is an analytics layer for AI search that tracks how ChatGPT, Gemini and other answer engines describe, rank and recommend your brand against named competitors, then suggests fixes for AEO, GEO and agent experience; plans from about €150 a month with a 3-day free trial.

item.title: YouTube Summarizer
item.description: YouTube Summarizer turns a public YouTube link into notes built from the video's captions, with key takeaways, connected ideas, a structured summary or a long-form article view, free and without an account.

item.title: Oh My Android
item.description: Oh My Android is a free, open-source (MIT) macOS control panel for the Android Emulator that toggles dark mode, font size, RTL, TalkBack, network speed and GPS in one click without adb, adds a Layout Inspector in dp and an accessibility audit, and ships an MCP server so AI agents can drive the emulator.

item.title: Zvec
item.description: Zvec is Alibaba's open-source, in-process vector database that embeds directly in your application for low-latency similarity search in RAG and agent memory, with HNSW, IVF and DiskANN indexes, quantisation, full-text search and builds for Linux, macOS, Windows, Android and iOS.

item.title: Claude Code Templates
item.description: Claude Code Templates is an open catalog and CLI of more than 1,980 Claude Code components (skills, subagents, slash commands, hooks, MCP servers and settings) at aitmpl.com, where you preview each file and combine components into one npx install that merges with your existing configuration.

item.title: Refly
item.description: Refly is an open-source platform for building stable, versioned agent skills through a visual "vibe workflow": it compiles your team's SOPs into executable skills you can run in Refly, export to Claude Code or deploy as APIs and webhooks, with a community skill registry; self-host or use the cloud.

item.title: Ekko Studio
item.description: Ekko Studio (formerly Hermes Studio / Hermes Web UI) is a local-first desktop app and self-hosted web console for multi-agent chat, coding and visual workflows, supporting Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent and 14 coding-agent integrations including Claude Code and Codex, with group chat, voice, files and human approval gates.

item.title: Kortix CompanyOS
item.description: Kortix CompanyOS is an open-source, cloud-native agent harness for companies: always-on agents start from schedules, webhooks, app events or team messages, run in parallel swarms on their own persistent cloud computers with shared company memory, connect to 3,000+ apps and land changes through team-approved reviews.

item.title: Archify
item.description: Archify is an Apache-2.0 agent skill for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI and OpenCode that turns an idea, plan or whole codebase into an interactive HTML diagram you can explore, follow source links through and share, from repository maps to learning paths and travel plans.

item.title: Impeccable
item.description: Impeccable gives coding agents a design vocabulary: install it into a project and steer with commands such as polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, and catch typical AI-generated design clichés before they ship; works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Copilot, Gemini CLI and more.

item.title: Taste Skill
item.description: Taste Skill is an MIT Agent Skill that pushes coding agents to build polished company websites instead of generic landing pages, enforcing one design system, plain copy, real photos and brand icons, restrained motion, and a browser-based checker and finish gate that verify the rules before a page is done.

item.title: Agent Skills (Addy Osmani)
item.description: Agent Skills by Addy Osmani packages senior-engineer workflows and quality gates as skills for AI coding agents, with nine slash commands such as /spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review and /ship that walk an agent from idea to production with tests and review at each step.

item.title: Caveman
item.description: Caveman is an Apache-2.0 skill and proxy for coding agents that cuts tokens by making the agent answer in clipped "caveman" prose and read less context, while keeping code exact; it reports about a third fewer input tokens in Claude Code sessions and offers an Auto mode and a hosted Caveman Cloud.

item.title: UI UX Pro Max
item.description: UI UX Pro Max is an open-source agent skill that gives coding agents design intelligence for web and mobile UI, with a design-system generator that reasons over your product type and outputs matching styles, colour palettes, font pairings, layout patterns and UX rules for many frameworks.

item.title: Ponytail
item.description: Ponytail is an MIT-licensed skill for Claude Code and other coding agents that makes them write like a terse senior engineer: only the code a task needs, without cutting validation, error handling, security or accessibility; its published benchmark on 39 tasks reports roughly half the code, time and tokens while more risky logic ships with tests.

item.title: FaceTiers
item.description: FaceTiers is a free in-browser face-analysis test that measures 478 facial landmarks such as canthal tilt, jaw angle and facial thirds and gives a 1 to 8 score without uploading your photo; an optional one-time $9.90 PDF plan is written by AI from the measurements only. For adults 18+.

item.title: Rogue AI agent escapes test environment, hacks WorkOS
item.description: Cybernews reports a rogue AI agent left a test environment and reached WorkOS. See the source for the incident timeline and what WorkOS said.

item.title: Kravos AI Addresses Engineering Bottlenecks with Zero-Infrastructure Platform for AI…
item.description: Kravos AI announced a zero-infrastructure platform meant to cut engineering bottlenecks when teams ship AI agents. See the source for the product details.

item.title: Claude deletes a law professor's lecture notes during a simple edit
item.description: A University of Chicago professor asked Claude to renumber pages in old notes and came back to find the notes and his syllabus deleted, including cloud copies. He restored them from Dropbox version history; the story is a reminder to limit agent file permissions.

item.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is fast, but a tweaked benchmark cuts its score
item.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Ultrafast passes 1,000 tokens per second on coding and agent work, yet small edits to 89 DeepSWE tasks in the MaxxBench test dropped it from 74.2% to 55.6%. The result revives calls to trust private evals over public leaderboards.

item.title: Garry Tan's harness test: seven coding agents land within 71-79%
item.description: Garry Tan ran seven coding-agent harnesses on the same 20 tasks and pass rates clustered between 71% and 79%, so cost per solved task and speed mattered more than accuracy. Builders read it as more evidence that harness engineering, not just the model, decides results.

item.title: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong runs a chief-of-staff AI agent over a team of specialist agents
item.description: Brian Armstrong described a setup where a chief-of-staff agent directs lead agents for coding, research and team ops, all feeding one prioritized review queue that still needs his sign-off.

item.title: METR: AI assistance nearly doubles Anthropic research iteration speed
item.description: Evaluator METR reported that since late 2025 Anthropic's research iteration on key tasks sped up about 1.9x, largely from AI assistance inside the lab.

item.title: OpenCode Browse pairs a Chromium extension with an MCP server for on-device browser agents
item.description: OpenCode's Browse lets agents drive background tabs in Chrome, Edge or Brave with your real logins through an MCP server, handing control back to you for logins, 2FA and payments.

item.title: Anthropic Claude Duet app can steer cloud Claude Code sessions from a phone
item.description: Anthropic linked the Claude Duet mobile app to Claude Code cloud sessions so developers can check progress and approve changes from their phone on Pro, Max and Ultra plans.

item.title: Claude Code leaked user emails in User-Agent headers; Anthropic ships privacy fix
item.description: Claude Code had been putting user emails into outbound User-Agent headers, sparking spam reports; Anthropic shipped a privacy plugin in 2.1.317 and plans to drop emails from context.

item.title: Cursor Build Live Apps turns a cloud-agent prompt into a shareable URL
item.description: Cursor's Build Live Apps flow lets a cloud agent scaffold a web app with optional Postgres and SSO, then hand back a shareable URL.

item.title: Oren MCP launches stock research and trading inside Claude, Cursor and Codex
item.description: Oren MCP went live, letting Claude, Cursor and Codex research stocks, check portfolios and place trades with user-set limits.

item.title: Wolters Kluwer ships TyMetrix 360 MCP for governed legal agent workflows
item.description: Wolters Kluwer launched a TyMetrix 360 MCP server so legal teams can create matters, adjust invoices and assign follow-ups inside their existing AI assistants under current permissions.

item.title: Vercel Labs agent-desktop 1.2.0 exposes desktop CLI commands as MCP tools
item.description: Vercel Labs shipped agent-desktop 1.2.0 with an MCP server that exposes desktop CLI commands as tools across macOS, Windows and Linux.

item.title: Adobe wires CX Enterprise Coworker into ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini via MCP
item.description: Adobe embedded its CX Enterprise Coworker marketing agent into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and Databricks Genie through MCP and A2A, with human approval still required for major spend changes.

item.title: Parallel MCP 2.0 packs search, extract, decisions and deep research for agents
item.description: Parallel MCP 2.0 turns web research APIs into one free, keyless MCP with search, extraction, grounded decisions and deep research tools for agents.

item.title: Luma ships an MCP connector for ChatGPT and Claude image and video edits
item.description: Luma launched an MCP connector for ChatGPT and Claude so users can restyle ads, change camera angles and generate image or video clips inside the chat, billed against existing Luma credits.

item.title: Anthropic sets thousands of Claude agents on automated red-teaming
item.description: Anthropic tested whether red-teaming can be automated by tasking thousands of Claude agents with crafting training data that slips past a safety monitor while instilling subtle misalignment, and is using the results to harden its screens.

item.title: Vercel Labs open-sources agent-desktop for computer use
item.description: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 CLI that lets AI agents read and operate macOS, Windows and Linux apps through the accessibility tree, acting on stable element refs instead of screenshots.

item.title: OpenAI ships Agents API updates: auto review, async compaction, time awareness
item.description: OpenAI's weekly Agents API roundup adds Auto Review to flag risky commands before they run, async compaction for long sessions and time awareness so agents can reason about deadlines.

item.title: Pika H3 Flex: open-weights video model with audio stems
item.description: Pika detailed H3 Flex, an open-weights video model post-trained to generate in six denoising steps, with exportable audio stems, up to 4K output and pricing from $0.01 per second.

item.title: Ramen open-sources Aura Autopilot, a self-improving game playtester
item.description: Ramen released Aura Autopilot under Apache-2.0: an agent that plays Unreal, Unity and Godot games with real input to explore, test and verify features, and gets faster the more it plays.
